text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa didn't show up even though 
it was time for training, so while I was 
searching around for her...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Soaring like I'm flying... DUNK SHOOOOT!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, scored on again~. Calling in 
El-chan as a ringer is totally unfair!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Slam dunks are my specialty since I 
can apply my aerial combat techniques, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, pass the ball to El! I'll show 
you a magnificent slam dunk!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... El-chan, your Trainer is here, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? Huh, Trainer-san. Did you come to 
cheer for El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right! I completely forgot!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I only intended to play for a bit, yes... 
But when it comes to competition, I get so 
absorbed...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I will be more careful next time. I am 
truly, truly sorry, desu...!
